citations.claim: controlled body moving fast, causing large velocity error
controller_force at violating step 14 is 579.898 exceeding limit 11.345
previous step force was clamped at limit 11.345

counterfactual.change: Increased fmax from 11.345 to 200.0 (one field) so kp*error no longer exceeds limit; scenario then passes without controller_force_limit violation.

explanation: Controller force is computed as kp * velocity_error without clamping to fmax. In shrunk scenario, body 1 has high speed ~50 m/s away from waypoint, kp=12 gives error force ~579.9 N which exceeds fmax=11.34 N. Checker at step 13 shows force exactly at limit (11.345), but at step 14 it spikes to 579.8 because clamping is missing. Increasing fmax to 200 makes scenario pass, proving cause.
vision_note: The red controller-driven body moves smoothly toward the green waypoint in steps 11-13, then in step 14 it makes an abrupt large jump right onto the waypoint. No collision or other disturbance is visible to explain the jump.
